description: Debug front-end problems in the browser with Chrome DevTools: Console, Sources breakpoints, Network, Elements/computed styles, Application storage, Performance, and source maps; including debugging through an MCP/automation browser. Use when a page throws errors, a request fails or returns the wrong data, CSS does not apply, state or storage looks wrong, a bug only reproduces in the browser, or you need to turn a vague "it's broken" into a minimal repro with evidence. Do not use for writing automated tests (playwright-testing), general non-browser debugging method (debugging-workflow), Node.js server debugging (nodejs-development), or security testing (web-security-testing).
